HISTORICAL SNAPSHOT: Imported for provenance. This diagram models 2026-07-22 behavior
and is not a current runtime or readiness authority. See docs/actions/README.md.

================================================================================
 JULES PR WORKFLOWS — INTENDED USE, AUTOMATIC TRIGGERS & AUTOMERGE FRAMEWORK
 Source: docs/JULES_WORKFLOW_REASONING_AND_CHANGES.md (2026-07-22)
         + deployed .github/workflows/ (all 4 repos, verified 2026-07-22)
         + jules/docs/runbooks/github_integration.md (@jules vs /jules-*)
         + jules/docs/actions/workflows/{CHANGELOG,EDGE_CASES}.md
 Repos : EmailIntelligence (EI)
         gemini-fullstack-langgraph-quickstart (GFLQ)
         gemini-cli-prompt-library (GCPL)
         kaggle-notebooks-analysis (KNA)
================================================================================

 LEGEND
  [AUTO]  = fires automatically on GitHub events (no human label needed)
  [LABEL] = fires when a maintainer adds a label OR posts a slash command
  [SCHED] = fires on a cron schedule / workflow_dispatch
  RO      = read-only Jules session (no AUTO_CREATE_PR, no code mutation)
  MUT     = mutating Jules session (creates PR or pushes to branch)
  NO-SESS = does NOT create a Jules session (GitHub-side only)
  -->     = trigger direction
  ===>    = Jules REST API call
  ---|    = gate/decision
  [G]     = posts an HTML marker <!-- jules-* --> for downstream consumers

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 TWO COMMUNICATION MODES WITH JULES (do NOT conflate these)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @jules  (server-side, Jules GitHub App)
    - posted in a PR comment (issue_comment)
    - Jules App routes the message to the session that CREATED the PR
    - works ONLY on Jules-authored PRs (pr.user.login === 'jules')
    - does NOT create a new session, does NOT consume the 15/day quota
    - no workflow/secret needed — the Jules App handles it server-side
    - CRITICAL NUANCE: the review workflow skips jules-* branches, so
      Jules-created PRs typically do NOT have <!-- jules-pr-reviewer -->
      markers. The address-comments gate must use pr.user.login, NOT markers.
    - used by: jules-pr-address-comments.yml

  /jules-* (self-hosted GitHub Actions, REST API)
    - /jules-fix, /jules-resolve, /jules-rebuild, /jules-walkthrough,
      /jules-force-review
    - creates a NEW Jules session via POST /v1alpha/sessions
    - works on ANY PR (Jules-authored or human-authored)
    - consumes 1 session per invocation (2 for rebuild)
    - requires JULES_API_KEY secret + workflow file
    - custom text after the command becomes CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS

  WHY BOTH EXIST:
    - Session-creating workflows (/jules-*) start FRESH work: new review,
      new fix, new rebuild. They consume quota and can run on any PR.
    - @jules CONTINUES existing work: feeds human feedback to the session
      that already created the PR, without spending another session.
    - address-comments is the BRIDGE: human review thread -> @jules -> the
      Jules session that created the PR addresses the feedback.

================================================================================
 WORKFLOW TAXONOMY (8 deployed workflows across all 4 repos)
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1. jules-pr-review.yml            [AUTO]  RO   [G] | "the always-on reviewer"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_view]
  concorr : jules-review-<PR#>, cancel-in-progress: true
  skip if : head.ref starts with "jules-"  OR  label "jules-override" present
  fork    : skipped (same-repo only)
  session : YES — 1 analytical (RO) session from PR HEAD
  marker  : <!-- jules-pr-reviewer --> in the PR REVIEW BODY (pulls.createReview)
  output  : PR review + jules/review status (branch-protection gate)
  skipMk  : jules-pr-reviewer, jules-auto-fix, jules-resolve, jules-walkthrough,
            jules-rebuild, jules-quota-exhausted, jules-address-comments  [✅ FIXED]
  checksum: 486820c26b844dff5bf05a53c5ff2f40 (identical, all 4 repos)

  pull_request event ---> [fork? jules-* branch? override?] --no--> skip
                          | yes (same-repo, eligible)
                          v
                  create Jules session (start: pr.head.ref, RO)
                          ===> poll /v1alpha/sessions/<name>/activities
                          v
                  parse VERDICT: approve|comment|block
                          v
                  post PR review (with marker) + set jules/review status

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2. jules-pr-force-review.yml      [LABEL] RO   [G] | "manual override review"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [labeled: jules-force-review]
            OR issue_comment [/jules-force-review]
  concorr : jules-force-review-<PR#>, cancel-in-progress: false
  session : YES — 1 analytical (RO) session from PR HEAD
  marker  : <!-- jules-pr-reviewer --> in the PR review body
  output  : PR review + jules/review status
  skipMk  : (same as review)  [✅ FIXED]
  checksum: e1adfc711b6b87d0487c3c173601da71 (identical, all 4 repos)

  maintainer adds label jules-force-review  (or /jules-force-review comment)
        ---> remove label (claim) ---> create RO session from PR HEAD
        ===> poll ---> post review (with marker) + status

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 3. jules-pr-walkthrough.yml       [LABEL] RO   [G] | "reviewer's narrative"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [labeled: jules-walkthrough]
            OR issue_comment [/jules-walkthrough]
  session : YES — 1 analytical (RO) session from PR HEAD
  marker  : <!-- jules-walkthrough --> in an issue comment (upserted)
  output  : single maintained PR comment
  skipMk  : (same as review)  [✅ FIXED]
  checksum: b56585c158fc5447c2af22c38082a484 (identical, all 4 repos)

  label/comment ---> create RO session (start: pr.head.ref)
        ===> poll ---> upsert <!-- jules-walkthrough --> comment

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 4. jules-pr-auto-fix.yml          [LABEL] MUT  [G] | "PR-feedback-driven repair"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [labeled: jules-fix]
            OR issue_comment [/jules-fix]
  concorr : jules-fix-<PR#>, cancel-in-progress: false
  session : YES — 1 MUTATING session from PR HEAD
  marker  : <!-- jules-auto-fix -->; <!-- jules-quota-exhausted --> on 429
  output  : a follow-up repair PR
  skipMk  : jules-pr-reviewer, jules-auto-fix, jules-resolve,
            jules-rebuild, jules-quota-exhausted, jules-address-comments  [✅ FIXED]
            (walkthrough intentionally NOT skipped — architectural context helps fixes)
  checksum: 3d079f550f84fb5ed401d6d5c7ce99c9 (identical, all 4 repos)

  label jules-fix ---> consume label ---> create MUT session (start: pr.head.ref)
        ===> poll ---> Jules pushes fix ---> opens repair PR

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 5. jules-pr-resolve-conflicts.yml [LABEL] MUT  [G] | "stable-source reimplementation"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [labeled: jules-resolve]
            OR issue_comment [/jules-resolve]
  timeout : 45 min (stability watch + session)
  session : YES — 1 MUTATING session from current base (not PR HEAD)
  marker  : <!-- jules-resolve --> (upserted); <!-- jules-quota-exhausted --> on 429
  output  : a conflict-resolution PR (or organic-skip notice)
  skipMk  : jules-pr-reviewer, jules-auto-fix, jules-resolve,
            jules-rebuild, jules-quota-exhausted, jules-address-comments  [✅ FIXED]
  checksum: ccb022921d0b0c16550c72240977fec5 (identical, all 4 repos)

  label jules-resolve ---> validate base ref (git rev-parse -q --verify)
        | missing ref ---------> has_conflicts=error, exit 1 (FAIL) [✅ FIXED]
        v ref exists
        merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/<base>
        | exit 0 (clean) ---------> skip, post "conflicts resolved organically"
        | exit 1 (conflict) -----> stability watch (60s, no sessions)
        v
        recheck ---still clean---> skip
        | still conflict
        v
        create MUT session (start: base, pin source head SHA)
        ===> poll ---> open resolution PR

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 6. jules-pr-rebuild.yml           [LABEL] MUT  [G] | "two-session messy-PR cleanup"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request [labeled: jules-rebuild]
            OR issue_comment [/jules-rebuild]
  job 1 ANALYZE (RO): from base, comment-only — identify valuable vs noise
  job 2 REBUILD  (MUT): gated by needs.analyze.session_state == 'COMPLETED'
      AND same-repo PR. Starts from PR HEAD, reads job-1 analysis, PUSHES
      DIRECTLY to the PR branch (no new PR)
  session : YES — 2 sessions (1 RO analyze + 1 MUT rebuild)
  marker  : <!-- jules-rebuild --> (upserted); <!-- jules-quota-exhausted --> on 429
  output  : rewritten PR branch
  skipMk  : NONE — still has no skipMarkers  ❌ GAP (R1)
  checksum: 7c09fd82af471a7af1babbeb7bd0bc32 (identical, all 4 repos)

  label jules-rebuild
      ---> ANALYZE job (RO session from base)
      ===> poll ---> session_state output
      |  FAILED / TIMEOUT / skip -----> REBUILD job skipped (gated)
      v  COMPLETED
      REBUILD job (MUT session from pr.head.ref) ---> push to PR branch

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 7. jules-pr-address-comments.yml  [AUTO]  NO-SESS [G] | "human-review -> @jules loop"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : pull_request_review_comment [created]
  concorr : jules-address-<PR#>, cancel-in-progress: false
  skip if : comment author == 'jules'
  session : NO — does NOT call Jules REST API; posts @jules for the Jules App
  does    : (a) GATE: check pr.user.login === 'jules' — skip if not Jules-created
                (no session to route @jules to). EI removed the marker gate
                entirely; GFLQ/KNA/GCPL still check markers first then
                pr.user.login. EI's approach is correct because the review
                workflow skips jules-* branches, so Jules-created PRs typically
                have NO markers. [DIVERGENCE — see R2]
            (b) fetch issue comments + PR reviews for prior Jules context
                extraction (markers used for context, not for gate)
            (c) query GraphQL pullRequest.reviewThreads, filter isResolved == false
            (d) compose ONE smart summary with all unresolved thread context
            (e) post a SINGLE @jules PR issue comment (NOT per-thread replies —
                per-thread replies re-trigger this workflow causing a loop)
            (f) Jules App picks up @jules server-side and routes to the session
  marker  : <!-- jules-address-comments --> in the posted @jules PR comment
  output  : single @jules PR comment with unresolved thread summaries
  skipMk  : N/A (does not build prompt context from prior comments)
  checksum: DIVERGES — EI=ebbdfbb (no marker gate), others=d83ae29 (marker+login gate)

  review comment created (not by jules)
      |
      |--- EI path:
      |    pr.user.login === 'jules'? --no--> skip
      |    | yes
      |    v
      |    GraphQL reviewThreads(isResolved:false)
      |    ---> compose single summary
      |    ---> post ONE @jules PR comment with <!-- jules-address-comments -->
      |
      |--- GFLQ/KNA/GCPL path:
      |    markers in issue comments OR review bodies? --no--> skip
      |    | yes
      |    v
      |    pr.user.login === 'jules'? --no--> skip
      |    | yes
      |    v
      |    GraphQL reviewThreads(isResolved:false)
      |    ---> compose single summary
      |    ---> post ONE @jules PR comment with <!-- jules-address-comments -->
      |
      v
  Jules App routes @jules to the session that created the PR

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 8. jules-pr-automerge-label.yml   [SCHED] NO-SESS   | "automerge provenance labeler"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  trigger : schedule cron '0 * * * *' (hourly)  +  workflow_dispatch
  session : NO — pure GitHub API (no Jules involvement)
  does    : paginate ALL open PRs; for PRs whose author login === 'jules'
            AND head.repo == same repository, add the 'automerge' label.
            THEN (GFLQ/KNA only): call enablePullRequestAutoMerge GraphQL
            mutation to enable GitHub's native auto-merge on the PR.
            EI/GCPL do NOT call enablePullRequestAutoMerge (Mergify handles it).
  output  : 'automerge' label + (GFLQ/KNA) native auto-merge enabled per-PR
  checksum: 3 VARIANTS (expected):
            EI=a5bb1a7 (Mergify, no GraphQL call)
            GCPL=8d3ed62 (Mergify, no GraphQL call)
            GFLQ/KNA=74ac6b7 (native auto-merge, calls GraphQL)

  hourly cron / manual run
      ---> paginate open PRs
      ---> PR.author == 'jules' && head.repo == this repo ?
        | yes ---> add label 'automerge'
        |          + (GFLQ/KNA) call enablePullRequestAutoMerge GraphQL
        v
      MERGE ENGINE (per repo, external to this workflow) — see below

================================================================================
 HTML MARKER PRODUCER/CONSUMER MATRIX  (<!-- jules-* -->)
================================================================================
 Markers serve THREE purposes. Do NOT delete a marker before understanding all
 three roles it plays.

 PURPOSE 1 — CIRCULAR CONTEXT PREVENTION (skipMarkers filtering)
   Session-creating workflows EXCLUDE comments containing any skipMarkers
   marker so Jules does not read its own prior output as "human feedback."

 PURPOSE 2 — COMMENT LIFECYCLE (upsert / dedup)
   Walkthrough and resolve-conflicts find their existing marker comment and
   UPDATE it instead of creating duplicates.

 PURPOSE 3 — PRIOR JULES ACTIVITY DETECTION
   Address-comments checks for ANY Jules marker (in issue comments AND review
   bodies) to extract prior Jules context for the @jules prompt. NOTE: EI
   version uses pr.user.login as the gate, not markers (see §5 of reasoning doc).

  Marker                        | Produced by        | Stored as         | Consumed by                     | Purpose
  ------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+--------
  <!-- jules-pr-reviewer -->    | review,force-review| PR review body     | skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF)     | 1,3
  <!-- jules-walkthrough -->    | walkthrough        | issue comment      | skipMarkers (rev,FR,walk); UPD  | 1,2,3
  <!-- jules-auto-fix -->       | auto-fix           | issue comment      | skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF)     | 1,3
  <!-- jules-resolve -->        | resolve-conflicts  | issue comment (UPD)| skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF); UPD| 1,2,3
  <!-- jules-rebuild -->        | rebuild (analyze)  | issue comment (UPD)| skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF) ✅  | 2,3
  <!-- jules-quota-exhausted -->| any WF on 429/403  | issue comment      | skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF) ✅  | 1
  <!-- jules-address-comments -->| address-comments  | issue comment      | skipMarkers (all 5 sess WF) ✅  | 1

  ✅ = fixed in this round (added to skipMarkers in all 5 session-creating WFs)
  ❌ GAP: rebuild still has NO skipMarkers array (R1)

================================================================================
 AUTOMERGE FRAMEWORK ACROSS REPOS (UPDATED 2026-07-22 — all gaps now closed)
================================================================================

 The Jules workflows themselves NEVER merge. Automerge is a two-layer system:

  LAYER 1 — LABELER (jules-pr-automerge-label.yml, all 4 repos)
      - hourly cron, paginates open PRs
      - trusts ONLY: pr.user.login === 'jules'  AND  pr.head.repo.full_name
        === '<owner>/<repo>' (same-repo head — branch-name trust was removed)
      - adds label: 'automerge'
      - GFLQ/KNA: also calls enablePullRequestAutoMerge GraphQL (native auto-merge)
      - EI/GCPL: does NOT call GraphQL (Mergify handles the merge)
      - secrets/permissions: pull-requests: write, contents: read (no merge)

  LAYER 2 — MERGE ENGINE (per repo, external to Jules workflows)
      - EmailIntelligence (EI):
          Mergify (.mergify.yml) — ✅ has 'automerge' label rule
          Rule: label=automerge + check-success(test|lint-only) + -conflict + -draft
          Also: conflict comments to @jules, dependabot auto-merge, office-hours
          STATUS: ✅ FULLY CONFIGURED
      - gemini-cli-prompt-library (GCPL):
          Mergify (.mergify.yml) — ✅ NOW has 'automerge' label rule (P3 fix)
          Rule: label=automerge + check-success(SonarCloud,CodeQL,lint) + -conflict + -draft
          Also: office-hours merge, auto-rebase, conflict ping
          STATUS: ✅ FULLY CONFIGURED
      - gemini-fullstack-langgraph-quickstart (GFLQ):
          NO Mergify — uses GitHub native auto-merge
          jules-pr-automerge-label.yml calls enablePullRequestAutoMerge ✅ (P2 fix)
          Requires: Settings > General > Pull Requests > Allow auto-merge enabled
          Also: dependabot-auto-merge.yml for Dependabot only
          STATUS: ✅ CONFIGURED (if repo setting is enabled)
      - kaggle-notebooks-analysis (KNA):
          NO Mergify — uses GitHub native auto-merge
          jules-pr-automerge-label.yml calls enablePullRequestAutoMerge ✅ (P2 fix)
          Requires: Settings > General > Pull Requests > Allow auto-merge enabled
          STATUS: ✅ CONFIGURED (if repo setting is enabled)

  WHAT MERGIFY ADDS OVER NATIVE GITHUB AUTO-MERGE:
      Feature                      | GitHub native | Mergify
      -----------------------------+---------------+--------
      Auto-merge when checks pass  | ✅            | ✅
      Label-based conditional rules| ❌ (all/none) | ✅
      Author-based rules           | ❌            | ✅ (dependabot, jules)
      Schedule-based merging       | ❌            | ✅ (office hours)
      Automatic rebase when behind | ❌            | ✅ (threshold)
      Conflict detection comments  | ❌            | ✅ (auto-comment)
      Merge queues/batching        | limited       | ✅ (more configurable)
      Approval counting in rules   | ❌            | ✅ (#approved-reviews-by>=N)
      Cost                         | free          | free OSS / paid private

================================================================================
 TRUNK.IO ROLE (NOT a merge tool — it GATES merging)
================================================================================
  Trunk.io is a meta-linter/tooling platform, NOT a merge engine.
  Configured via .trunk/trunk.yaml in each repo.

  What it does:
    - Runs linters/formatters on PR code: actionlint, shellcheck, ruff, black,
      semgrep, mypy, eslint, hadolint, checkov, trufflehog, etc.
    - Runs as a GitHub Action or pre-push hook
    - Produces status checks on PRs (e.g., "Trunk Check" pass/fail)

  How it fits into auto-merge:
    1. Trunk.io runs on PR events → produces status checks
    2. Branch protection requires those checks to pass
    3. Mergify / GitHub auto-merge waits for ALL required checks (including
       Trunk Check AND jules/review AND CI) to pass
    4. Only when ALL required checks pass does the PR auto-merge

  Trunk.io GATES merging — it does not PERFORM merging.

================================================================================
 REQUIRED BRANCH PROTECTION / SETTINGS (for the gate to be meaningful)
================================================================================
  - branch protection requires status check: jules/review
  - branch protection requires status check: Trunk Check (if Trunk.io enabled)
  - branch protection requires status check: test / lint / CI
  - auto-merge enabled in repo settings (Settings → General → Pull Requests)
    [REQUIRED for GFLQ/KNA — Mergify repos don't need this]
  - 'automerge' label consumed by merge engine (Mergify rule or native auto-merge)
  - Jules GitHub App installed on the repo (author identity = 'jules')
  - JULES_API_KEY secret available to same-repo PR events
    (NOT exposed to fork PRs — fork paths skip before any secret use)

================================================================================
 SECURITY POSTURE (intended)
================================================================================
  - read-only workflows (review/force-review/walkthrough/address-comments/
    automerge-label) omit AUTO_CREATE_PR -> cannot spawn PRs
  - mutating workflows (auto-fix/resolve-conflicts/rebuild) are the only
    ones that create PRs / push, and only via maintainer label or slash cmd
  - no workflow uses pull_request_target (avoids elevated fork secret risk)
  - fork PRs are detected and skipped before checkout / secret use
  - same-repo head verification in automerge-label prevents fork spoof vector

================================================================================
 END-TO-END AUTO FLOW (how a Jules-authored PR gets reviewed, fixed, merged)
================================================================================

  [Jules opens PR from a label/issue task]
        |
        v
  jules-pr-review.yml [AUTO] fires on opened/synchronize
        ---> BUT skips jules-* branches! (Jules PRs typically NOT auto-reviewed)
        ===> sets jules/review status (gate) [only on non-jules-* branches]
        |
        +-- maintainer sees findings, adds label jules-fix
        |       v
        |   jules-pr-auto-fix.yml [LABEL] -> MUT session from PR HEAD -> repair PR
        |
        +-- maintainer comments on a review thread
        |       v
        |   jules-pr-address-comments.yml [AUTO] fires on review_comment:created
        |       -> GATE: pr.user.login === 'jules'? (EI: only check; others: markers+login)
        |       -> GraphQL: unresolved review threads
        |       -> posts ONE @jules PR comment with thread summaries
        |       -> Jules App routes @jules to the session that created the PR
        |          (NO new session consumed — reuses the existing one)
        |
        +-- conflicts on base advance?
        |       v
        |   jules-pr-resolve-conflicts.yml [LABEL jules-resolve]
        |       -> validates base ref -> merge-tree check -> stability watch
        |       -> MUT session from base -> resolution PR
        |
        +-- messy PR needs cleanup?
        |       v
        |   jules-pr-rebuild.yml [LABEL jules-rebuild]
        |       -> ANALYZE (RO) -> REBUILD (MUT) -> push to PR branch
        |
        v
  jules-pr-automerge-label.yml [SCHED hourly]
        ---> author=='jules' && same-repo head? -> add 'automerge' label
        ---> (GFLQ/KNA) also call enablePullRequestAutoMerge GraphQL
        v
  MERGE ENGINE:
    EI    : Mergify consumes 'automerge' label + checks pass -> MERGE ✅
    GCPL  : Mergify consumes 'automerge' label + checks pass -> MERGE ✅ (P3 fix)
    GFLQ  : GitHub native auto-merge (enablePullRequestAutoMerge called) -> MERGE ✅ (P2 fix)
    KNA   : GitHub native auto-merge (enablePullRequestAutoMerge called) -> MERGE ✅ (P2 fix)
        |
        v
  All required checks must pass BEFORE merge:
    [jules/review status]  +  [Trunk Check]  +  [test/lint/CI]  +  [-conflict]  +  [-draft]
        |
        v
  MERGE (squash/merge/rebase per repo setting)
